products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau De Parfum is a daring and dark oriental men’s perfume for those who appreciate strong and profound scents. It starts with a combination of spicy saffron, fresh neroli and light floral notes. As it settles, you can smell sweet apricot, warm amber and woody cedar that gives it richness. The final stage of the fragrance is very powerful and manly with leather, oud and patchouli that give the impression of being smoky, warm and powerful.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code EDT for men is a fresh seductive scent with bright green mandarin top, clean lavender heart, warm tonka bean cedar base. It came out in 2023, made refillable with sustainable ingredients. People in the fragrance world love it as the modern take on seduction, clean yet warm, great for guys who want to smell put together, nice trail and lasting power.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a fresh, masculine fragrance inspired by the deep blue sea and the energy of ocean waves. It’s a scent that feels clean, refreshing, and full of life, perfect for men who want to smell crisp and confident all day.

The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy mandarin and orange, blended with the green freshness of petitgrain. At the heart, unique marine notes of seaweed meet soft lavender and cotton flower, giving it a cool yet sophisticated vibe. The base brings warmth and depth with Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber, making it long-lasting and memorable.

Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is like stepping out of the ocean on a sunny day, fresh, cool, and effortlessly stylish. It’s perfect for men who want a clean signature scent for daily wear.

products.title: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum is a sweet fruity fragrance designed for ladies who adore subtle, playful scents. The top notes are juicy berries, cherry, and orange, which are fresh and fun. Gradually, rose, white flowers, and vanilla reveal their creamy and smooth characters. The bottom line is made up of powdery notes, musk, and amber, which combine to give a gentle warm finish. This perfume is to be considered feminine, comforting and friendly, and so it is ideal for everyday wear.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense is a captivating and luxurious unisex fragrance that wraps you in a warm and inviting embrace. This modern scent is a beautiful combination of spicy, sweet, and woody notes, creating an experience that is both comforting and sophisticated. Inspired by the rich heritage of Middle Eastern perfumery, Aariz Intense offers a contemporary twist that is perfect for those who want to make a statement.

Aariz Intense is a fragrance that exudes confidence and charm. It's the perfect accessory for anyone who loves a scent that is both powerful and elegant, leaving a memorable trail wherever you go. A single spray of Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense will transport you to a world of modern luxury, filled with warmth and sweetness.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix Royal X Taboo Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix Royal X Taboo Extrait de Parfum is a thick and dense perfume that is warm, smooth and not bold. It begins with a sweet and warm aroma of spicy cardamom and cinnamon. Gradually, the smell becomes a warm tobacco and cashmere wood smell, and it is a classy and addictive one. Vanilla, tonka bean, and dry woods remain on skin throughout the day in the dry down. The perfume is luxurious, powerful, and ideal to those who prefer having a strong and lasting perfume.

products.title: French Avenue Genesis Capricon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Genesis Capricorn Eau de Parfum is a deep, smoky and warm unisex perfume made for people who like bold and dark scents. It opens with strong incense and smoky notes that feel mysterious and calming at the same time. The middle has labdanum and balsam fir, which adds a resin like, forest touch that feels rich and smooth. As it settles, the base becomes warm and slightly sweet with benzoin, guaiac wood, amber and soft vanilla.

products.title: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet classy men’s perfume for those who like a clean but strong smell. It opens with watery sea notes mixed with citrus and green touch, then slowly turns floral and soft in the middle. The drydown is warm, woody and musky, which gives a creamy, long lasting feel.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong oriental-woody scent made for men who enjoy deep, sweet, smoky perfumes. It starts with caramel, licorice, guaiac wood, and cedar. Then it develops in the direction of warm and sweet heart notes of oud, sugar, sandalwood and cashmere wood. The base is creamy and dense with incense, vanilla, amber, oakmoss and musk.

products.title: Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper is a strong, spicy, and sweet fragrance that is bold but soft on the skin at the same time. It has a bright blend of pink pepper, saffron, and bergamot, with a spicy-sweet start, on top. After that, it goes to a magnificent rose and vanilla orchid heart, coming very floral, creamy, and a bit sweet. The bottom notes of amber, sandalwood, patchouli, and musk impart warmth, smoothness, and longevity to the fragrance. It is a perfume that exudes confidence, playfulness, and the ideal choice for a person who enjoys both sweet and spicy scents simultaneously.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum is a Women Floral perfume. Illicit was launched in 2015. The nose in this perfume is Anne Flipo. It begins with new and hot tones of ginger and bitter orange. It contains jasmine sambac, orange blossom and rose in the heart. The foundation is warm and salty with honey, amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood and wood of cashmere.

products.title: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, deep and very luxurious unisex perfume. This fragrance feels smooth, warm and comforting with a strong artistic touch. It opens soft and slightly sweet, then slowly turns creamy, floral and woody. Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2024 and the extract concentration makes it intense, long lasting and very elegant on the skin.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum is a Chypre perfume that targets women. Mad Madame was launched in 2012. The smell starts off with the fragrance of rose, black currant, amber and freesia. Patchouli, moss, tuberose, peony and jasmine are characteristic of the heart. It has a deep and warm base that is composed of castoreum, white musk, tolu balsam and vanilla absolute. It is a strong perfume targeted at confident women who prefer strong and persistent perfumes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum is very deep and rich. It feels warm, kinda Middle Eastern. It is fancy and bold. They made Oud Touch in 2014. It starts sweet. You smell caramel, raspberry, and orange. This is a smooth, little fruity start. Next, you smell flowers and earth. That is rose, jasmine, and patchouli. This mixes well with the last smells. Those are amber, vanilla, and musk. Franck Olivier Oud Touch is for guys who want a smell that is strong and stays a long time. Oud Touch is nice but easy to wear. It is best for nighttime or big events. The sweet and warm wood smell is perfect. It makes people remember you.

products.title: Valentino Born in Roma The Gold Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Valentino Born in Roma The Gold Eau de Toilette is a contemporary and sophisticated fragrance for men that has a warm woody essence. The initial notes are composed of bright solar and spicy ones which give the perfume a fresh and lively character. A nutmeg note brings in a delicate spicy warmth, while cedar in the heart note adds a clean woody character. In the base notes, vanilla and amber combine to make the fragrance soft, warm, and soothing. This perfume is a reflection of the wearer’s style, self-assurance, and suitability for everyday use.

products.title: Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a graceful, women’s perfume. It is a soft yet creamy oriental style perfume, featuring fresh citrus and spicy top notes, blended with earthy woods and gentle florals in the middle and finished with warm, sweet base notes. The mix of pink pepper, bergamot, lemon, patchouli, vetiver, cedar, amber and oakmoss creates a smooth, elegant scent that feels classy yet easy to wear daily.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum is a warm and deep scent for Men and Women that mixes spicy, sweet and woody notes in a very smooth way. It opens with saffron, nutmeg and a touch of cinnamon that feels rich and spicy. The center note becomes a combination of oud, suede and sandalwood, which is soft, smoky and creamy and thus gives the fragrance a quite pleasant character. The amber and vanilla mix forming the dry-down is not only sweet but warm as well, and this base stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Sandalwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sandalwood by Ibraheem Al Qurashi is a warm, soft, and slightly sweet Oriental Floral perfume that suits both women and men. It opens with a juicy combination of raspberry and deep damask rose, creamy and smooth. The middle adds a powdery touch, combined with dry cedarwood, giving the scent a calm, elegant feel. The base is creamy, warm, and comforting with amber and strong sandalwood that stays long and feels very cosy. It is a simple, classy, and relaxing perfume loved by many who enjoy soft woody scents.

products.title: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance with a rich chocolate feel. Launched in 2025, this scent is warm, sweet and a little dark in nature. It opens with creamy chocolate mixed with fresh tangerine and soft amber, which gives a sweet yet smooth start. The middle note feels bold with leather and smoky incense, adding depth and character. Overall, French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is cozy, addictive and perfect for people who love chocolate based perfumes with a slightly bold touch.

products.title: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum is a gentle and elegant perfume to men, which is warm and soft on the skin. It commences with a light spicy touch of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin orange that is clean and fresh. Gradually, it shifts into a drying floral core of orris, geranium and rose that is relaxing and refined. The foundation of suede, amber and musk remains warm and comfortable for many hours, as soft cashmere.

products.title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Viking Cologne EDP for men is a bold and invigorating fragrance inspired by strength and adventure. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. The heart blends aromatic lavender, geranium, rosemary, sage, and nutmeg, creating a dynamic and spicy character. The base settles into warm and earthy notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, olibanum, and patchouli, giving it depth and lasting power. Viking Cologne is admired in the fragrance community for its balanced blend of citrus, spices, and woods, offering good projection and longevity.

products.title: Burberry Her Petals Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Petals Eau de Parfum is a bouquetine fragrance that is aimed at girls who like gentle and glamorous aromas. The perfume starts off with sweet and fresh wild berries, then evolves to the soft violet and jasmine core that results in clean, floral and soft scents. The amber base produces a calm and gentle effect that is maintained close to the skin. The perfume is feminine but still modern and easy to wear that is why it can be used in everyday life.

products.title: Ajmal Amber Wood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amber Wood Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume from Ajmal Perfumes. Launched in 2014, it is a warm and woody fragrance with a perfect balance of spicy, fruity and deep amber notes. The fragrance starts with fresh and aromatic top notes of cardamom, apple, lavender and white pepper. Cedar and orris give a woody and floral note in the middle, while rich amber, patchouli and deep woody notes compose the base.

products.title: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and smooth unisex scent from Riiffs. Launched in 2021, it is a creamy vanilla-forward fragrance that blends fruity, floral, spicy and woody tones in a very balanced way. The opening starts with soft vanilla orchid, juicy plum and jasmine. The middle feels sweet and cozy with tonka bean, cinnamon, suede, sugar, bark and rose. The base dries down into a warm blend of amber, patchouli, maple and musk, offering a creamy, slightly dark finish that stays close and pleasant on skin.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a profound, shadowy, and mighty aroma that imparts richness and smokiness. At the top, a powerful whiskey accord is the major player, giving a daring and alcoholic accent first. Gradually, spicy resins like cinnamon and coriander join in and heat things up. When it comes to the base note, the combination of tobacco and oud with incense and different types of woods results in a thick and opulent scent. This fragrance is bold, strong, and sophisticated at the same time and is made for those who like strong and adult-like perfumes.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Royal
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Royal is a sophisticated fragrance featuring fresh, spicy, and woody notes, designed for independent men. It begins with a lively combination of cardamom, tangerine, and bergamot that is distinctly clean and vibrant. The heart note comes through with very mild lavender and sage along with a hint of green from violet leaf. The base note is created by benzoin, cedar, and patchouli which contribute the warmth and the depth effect. This perfume has a very modern, elegant, and daring character, which makes it wonderful for everyday use and nightlife as well.

products.title: Mancera  Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and fruity unisex perfume. This fragrance opens with a blast of juicy fruits that feel bright, fresh and mouth watering. It has a sweet vibe but still feels classy and smooth. As the perfume settles, soft floral notes start to appear and balance the sweetness very well. The dry down is creamy, warm and musky, which stays on the skin for many hours. Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is bold, strong and very long lasting, perfect for people who love fruity and sweet perfumes with power.

products.title: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy and light fragrance made for both men and women. The fragrance is a combination of aldehydes with frangipani, jasmine sambac, and iris floral notes, giving the impression of a fresh night breeze. The base of the scent is composed of cashmeran, ambergris, and musk, which are warm notes that stay close to the skin.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum was launched in 1999. This citrus aromatic fragrance for women is an absolute favourite of working and easy-going women. Francis Kurkdijian is the perfumer behind this absolute fragrance. The top notes of this scent include Lemon, Bergamot, Mint, Orange Peel and Rhubarb. While the heart tones and the dried tones include Jasmine, Musk, Oakmoss, Fennel, Carnation, White Amber, Musk, Oakmoss, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Cloves and Amber.

products.title: Amouage  Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum is a rich, deep and powerful men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Amouage. It was launched in 2020 as a stronger and more intense version of the original Interlude Man. The scent opens with spicy and green notes of oregano, pimento and fresh bergamot. As it settles, the heart becomes dark and smoky with incense, amber, opoponax and labdanum. The base is heavy, warm and masculine, filled with smoke, oud, leather, patchouli and sandalwood.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Tease Creme Cloud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Victoria's Secret Tease Crème Cloud Eau De Parfum is an exquisite, gentle, and sugary perfume that is specifically designed for the women who are fond of soft and warm scents. The fragrance has a beginning which is a silky and luscious combination of vanilla and meringue that gives a feeling of sugar and comfort. The fragrance then moves to the heart of soft sandalwood which imparts a milky touch while the base and musk are laced with amber to provide warmth and make the scent last longer. The perfume has a very clean and sweet quality and is extremely soothing, perfect for daily use.

products.title: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a clean, fresh and classy men’s perfume from the house of Tom Ford. It is the sharp citrus beginning, spicy heart and smooth woody base that makes this perfume stand out among and an unpolished look and elegant feel of a man who wears it. The note of the vetiver continuously spreads its presence and gives a dry, earthy and confident aura during the entire wear of this perfume.

products.title: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum is a fresh yet deep unisex perfume inspired by the calm and wild Mediterranean coast. It opens with a bright and natural wave of Italian lemon that is very pleasant. It gradually transitions into green woody aromas of cypress and oak, creating a coastal forest scene. The base of amber and labdanum foundation imparts a mellow and smooth depth that is relaxed but upscale, so it can be worn daily with ease.

products.title: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum is a strong and bold unisex perfume that mixes rich oud with clean, warm leather. It is a deep and smooth scent that gives a powerful first impression and keeps the same strength for long hours. A mix of leather, oud, saffron, bergamot, cardamom, pepper and ambergris creates a smoky, spicy and warm smell that feels both classy and wild.

products.title: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 is a very sweet, fruity, and fresh perfume that is very bright from the first spray. The opening with juicy lychee, crisp red apple, and a tiny sparkle of lemon makes it very playful. In the middle, the soft violet, rose, and jasmine give a nice floral touch that is pleasant on skin. The dry down becomes warm and soothing with vanilla, sugar, musk, amber, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a cheerful, sugary, and girlish fragrance that is very suitable for daily use, informal occasions, and outdoor activities during the day.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette, a quintessentially oriental woody perfume for men, introduces its presence with the brightness of citrus and spices, then relaxes into the warmth of leather and vanilla. It has a character that is both timeless, luxurious, and slightly daring at the same time, thereby being suitable for men who prefer mature and assertive scents. It was the work of Jean-Paul Guerlain in 1988 and is still appreciated for its opulent and sophisticated character.

products.title: Givenchy Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum for women is a warm, elegant, and sensual fragrance that is classic and feminine. The first notes are spicy nutmeg, fresh bergamot, sweet gardenia, and soft flowers, then it is rich heart comprising tuberose, jasmine, iris, honeysuckle, and peony. The drydown is a mix of vanilla, amber, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and soft woods making it creamy and deep. The fragrance is described as a timeless scent with a smooth sweet and floral blend, which is ideal for women who prefer a bold but elegant perfume.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is made for women who love to feel confident and glamorous, and it was launched in 2005. This perfume combines fruity, floral and woody notes into a smooth and sensual composition. It opens with juicy pomegranate, sweet persimmon and a green accord. The middle notes bloom with exotic black orchid, lotus and champaca. Finally the base settles into warm mahogany, amber, black violet and creamy whipped notes.

Winner of the FiFi Award Fragrance of the Year Women’s Luxe 2006 Euphoria is one of the most popular perfumes from Calvin Klein known for its long-lasting performance and sensual appeal.

products.title: Bentley Silverlake Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and masculine fragrance that captures the spirit of adventure. Inspired by clear mountain air and sparkling lakes, this scent combines crisp citrus with cool aromatic notes, creating an energising and refreshing experience.

The fragrance opens with a shot of zesty lemon and cool mint, instantly boosting your freshness. At its heart, violet leaves, lavender, and pink pepper add a clean, slightly spicy, and green touch, making it both elegant and sporty. The base of white musk and amberwood brings a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish.

Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum exudes a classy yet casual charm, perfect for the man who appreciates both sophistication and the great outdoors. One spray is like stepping into a crisp morning by a mountain lake, surrounded by fresh air and endless horizons.

products.title: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a creamy oriental floral fragrance that combines classic Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern elegance. The scent opens with fresh rose and floral notes, moves to middle notes of agarwood and patchouli, and finishes with warm vanilla for a sensual, lasting impression. It’s perfect for people who love strong, elegant, and sophisticated perfumes.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum is a dark and strong men's perfume that has a sweet and woody touch. It begins with juicy pineapple and black currant, which smells opulent and faintly fruity. It becomes slowly warm with smoky aromas and spices which are very strong and manly. The dry down is creamy with vanilla, amber and woods that remain on the skin throughout long hours. This fragrance is strong, up-to-date and self-assured.

products.title: French Avenue Mystic Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Mystic Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and dark unisex fragrance. Released in 2024, this perfume starts with a smoky and spicy blend of saffron and incense that is mysterious right after a spray. The Sweet touch of sugar cane mixed with warm amber and soft violet is added in the middle and it adds a sense of balance and smoothness. The base settles into creamy sandalwood and earthy patchouli, leaving a strong leather like trail that feels classy and powerful but still wearable.

products.title: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum is a sumptuous, sugary, and elegant perfume for women that has a warm, and luxurious feeling. The top notes are represented by a delicate and mellow combination of honey, rum, and citrus that is soft and welcoming. The floral part is composed of orchid, jasmine, rose, and magnolia and makes the scent feel like its melting and softening into a woman. The warm notes of vanilla, sandalwood, and suede are the last to be felt and give depth and long-lasting warmth to the scent. This perfume feels to be the combination of elegance, audacity, and the best choice for women who are confident.

products.title: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and bright unisex fragrance from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Inspired by the Italian Riviera, this perfume feels like a cool sea breeze mixed with fresh citrus fruits and white flowers. It opens with sharp and juicy citrus notes blended with soft herbs, then moves into smooth neroli and orange flower and finally settles into a light musky and amber base.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a modern, masculine scent. Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum was released in 2023. It carries a creamy, woody amber style with a fresh citrus opening of grapefruit, a deep heart of woody notes and frankincense, and a warm base of vanilla and amber xtreme.

products.title: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait De Parfum is a soft, rich and elegant rose-based perfume made for women who truly love floral scents. It opens with a fresh and bright rose mixed with citrus fruits, which feels clean and uplifting. As the scent settles, it becomes more floral and smooth with jasmine and lily adding a gentle sweetness. With deep warmth, the base remains and continues with the scent of earth, resin and woody notes that linger on the skin for hours.

products.title: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern aquatic scent made for men who like a cool and classy smell. It starts with bright marine and citrus notes that are like a gentle sea breeze on the skin, turning spicy and soft gradually and finally, warm woody notes dominate the dry down. Due to the extrait concentration, the perfume feels light, refreshing and yet strong.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette is a classy and clean men’s perfume with a soft, sweet and woody feel. The first impression of the fragrance is a striking combination of herbs and spices with a tiny bit of fruit, but the transition to warmth and smoothness is rather slow. Along the way, the aroma becomes very soft and sweet.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum is a warm, fresh and slightly sweet men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright lemon and soft iris, giving a clean and crisp feel. After that, the perfume is the green, somewhat powdery heart of violet leaf. The end is sweet and manly with sandalwood, leather, ambergris and cedar.

products.title: Kayali Elixir 11 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Elixir 11 is a scent that is warm, deep, slightly sweet and feels bold right from the first spray. It is a fresh and soft sweet start, as the opening has rose petals mixed with juicy red apple touch. The heart has May rose and jasmine sambac in which the perfume smells floral, smooth, and a bit romantic. Later, patchouli, amber, and vanilla sink into the skin and give a rich, dark sweetness that lasts long. This fragrance is rich and confident, and it is ideal for those who love bold, sweet, floral perfumes.

products.title: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur EDP is a bold, truly sensual choice. It works for everyone—men and women. The scent is famous for its warm, spicy, and deep musk feel. Maurice Roucel created Musc Ravageur in 2000. It opens with fresh energy. You first smell lavender, tangerine, and bergamot. That clean burst soon fades. The center quickly moves to a rich mix: cinnamon, cloves, and rose. This makes the perfume smooth. It gives a light, powdery touch. The base is where it locks down. Expect deep warmth here. Musk, vanilla, amber, and woods dominate. This strong finish makes Musc Ravageur unforgettable. It feels cozy; it feels mysterious. The scent is known for staying warm and strong on your skin all day.

products.title: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau De Toilette is really smooth, and nice. It smells fresh, warm, and kinda mysterious all at the same time. When you first spray Night Touch, you get a bright smell of bergamot, pineapple, and cardamom - that’s a clean and energetic start. After a bit, you smell flowery and spicy stuff like geranium, nutmeg, and violet that makes Night Touch nice and balanced. The last smell you get is a rich, manly one with patchouli, musk, and amber that stays softly on your skin for a long time.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a deep, elegant, and modern fragrance for men who like to stand out without trying too hard. Intenso Pour Homme is all about pure instinct, a strong, masculine scent that balances rich, woody notes with fresh green touches.

This fragrance opens with fresh basil and watery notes that feel clean and sharp. In the heart, a unique blend of lavender, tobacco, and hay gives Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme a warm and slightly sweet feel. The base is where it gets deep and classy, with sandalwood, amber, labdanum, and musk giving a strong, long-lasting finish.

Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is perfect for the modern Indian man who wants to feel confident, sophisticated, and ready to leave a strong impression wherever he goes.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense For Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau Intense for women by Dolce & Gabbana boasts a refreshing Mediterranean summer character. It contains a citrus and green apple head note that transitions to soft, feminine floral notes resting on a warm, musky amberwood base. The perfume opens with lemon and Granny Smith apple, along with the heart note of jasmine and marigold, and rests on a gorgeous base of amberwood and musk. This is a bold and strong Eau De Parfum that lasts longer than earlier releases. Additionally, it offers versatility to wear every day, or as a complex fragrance, suitable for occasions that call for it.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Attar Al Youm Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Attar Al Youm Eau de Parfum is a fabulous and divine fragrance that mixes together floral and oriental notes. It starts off with a vibrant citrus and spice combination, afterwards gradually revealing a delicate heart of rose and jasmine, thus providing a rich and classy feel. The combination of amber and musk in the base gives off a warm and durable finish that lingers on the skin for a long time. This fragrance is for those who appreciate sophisticated, long-lasting perfumes that have the quality of being both modern and elegant.

products.title: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and classy men’s perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent is made for men who like a neat, modern and confident smell. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel fresh and energizing, then slowly moves into soft florals and green tones. Smooth, warm and slightly creamy with woods, musk and vanilla is the base, which gives a polished touch but at the same time is suitable for everyday wear.

products.title: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. It opens fresh but slowly turns dark, warm and very luxurious. The fragrance starts with bright citrus notes, then moves into soft florals and finally settles into a heavy oud and musky base. French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum feels classy, slightly wild and very strong in character.

products.title: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette is a bold, warm and rich unisex perfume made for people who love strong woody scents. The scent opens with the spicy notes of the hot and lively feel, then gradually intermingles with a warm and deep woodiness and increasingly comes on to a sweet, smoky oud base. The fragrance is still smooth on the skin and feels luxurious and powerful. Perfect if you are a fan of oud combined with spices and soft sweetness. The musk feels modern but has a slight Arabic like touch, making it suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Man Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum is a warm, woody, and fresh masculine perfume that feels bold but also soft in the drydown. It opens with clean and bright top notes of juniper, lavender, and lemon. The heart brings a smooth combination of orange blossom, nutmeg, and Spanish labdanum that adds warmth and depth. The base settles into dry wood, patchouli, and musk, giving a strong and charming finish. The blend feels modern, classy, and perfect for men who like deep and comforting scents.

products.title: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum is a lavish and harmonious perfumery where the warm, woodsy, and subtly sugary notes dominate. The perfume opens with gentle lavender, apple, and cinnamon that create a neat and elegant beginning. Gradually, the fragrance proceeds to a floral and woody heart consisting of rose and cedar. During the dry down phase, the oud, sandalwood, vanilla, and amber feel deep, creamy, and very rich. The fragrance is a bait, calming and giving off a powerful aura. It is ideally suited for those who are fond of wearing strong niche scents.

products.title: Riiffs Vendome Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Vendôme Eau de Parfum is a warm and classy men’s fragrance with a smooth oriental touch. It starts with fresh bergamot that feels bright and clean on the skin. After a few minutes, soft iris and roasted chestnut come in, giving it a creamy and slightly sweet feel. In the dry down, whiskey, woody notes, and amber create a deep, warm base that smells rich and confident. It feels modern, stylish, and perfect for men who like bold but smooth scents.

products.title: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum is a wealthy and bold unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Neesh. It is a deep, woody, spicy scent that opens with warm saffron, fruity plum and spicy cardamom and nutmeg. The heart feels smooth and sweet with leather, caramel, brown sugar and soft cashmere wood. The base is dark and long lasting with incense, vanilla, amber, patchouli, sandalwood, moss and vetiver, creating a warm, strong scent trail that smells classy and powerful.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette is a fresh yet warm scent that was introduced in 2018, made for everyday wear. It opens with a clean mix of mint, juniper berries, bergamot and pineapple that feels cool and energetic. The middle has soft floral notes like geranium, violet and orange blossom, which add smoothness. The base settles into woody, sweet tones of sandalwood, musk, vanilla and a hint of dark chocolate, giving a calm, modern finish.

products.title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir perfume is a women's fragrance that is sweet, bold, and playful with a rich and glamorous feeling. It starts with juicy wild berries along with a hint of mandarin orange and the impression is of freshness and fun. The heart of the fragrance consists of gardenia, jasmine, and honeysuckle which form the base of the creamy floral smell. The end notes of caramel, vanilla, amber, and sandalwood blend together to form a warm, sweet, and smooth base that lasts for many hours. The scent is perfect for women who love sweet, flirty, and feminine fragrances but with a little depth.

products.title: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum is an iconic fragrance for men with a woody-spicy character. It starts with a fresh and powdery note, then leads to a warm, spicy heart and finally ends on a dry woody note. It has the sophistication of the past, a hint of vintage, and is perfect for occasions when a self-assured, classic scent is desired.

products.title: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum is a strong woody scent made for both men and women. The scent was made by Jordi Fernández in 2024. The top notes are grapefruit, some spicy ginger, and bright bergamot. The middle note mixes Akigalawood, juicy lychee, and cedarwood, which gives it a warm, rich feel. The base rests on soft amberwood, dirt-like vetiver, patchouli, and smooth tonka bean, so the smell lasts a long time and feels totally balanced.

products.title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the green spirit of nature with a luxurious twist. Unlike traditional vetiver scents that use only the root, Creed uses the entire vetiver plant, leaves, roots, and heartwood, resulting in a smooth, earthy, and uplifting scent.

This unisex fragrance feels elegant yet sporty, perfect for people who love refreshing yet long-lasting perfumes. It opens with a crisp green burst and gradually melts into warm, woody softness. Creed Original Vetiver is ideal for anyone who wants to smell fresh, refined, and put-together throughout the day.

products.title: Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum is a deep, modern, and soulful fragrance that invites you on a journey of discovery. It’s more than just a scent; it’s an experience. Crafted for the confident individual, this perfume mix of warm spices, rich woods, and a hint of nutty sweetness to create a truly unforgettable aroma.

Reasons smell like finding comfort in sophistication. It wraps you in a warm, elegant embrace that is both powerful and peaceful. This fragrance is perfect for those who want a signature scent that tells a story of wisdom, confidence, and quiet strength. With Amouage Reasons, you don’t just enter a room, you bring a unique and captivating presence with you.

products.title: Amouage Jubilation XXV Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Jubilation XXV Man is not just a perfume; it's a statement of royalty, celebration, and timeless elegance.Crafted for the man who is a king in his own right, this fragrance is a true masterpiece of modern perfumery. Imagine stepping into a grand palace, filled with the rich aroma of sweet incense, exotic spices, and precious woods. That is the experience of Jubilation XXV.

This scent is incredibly rich, complex, and majestic. It captures a feeling of pure happiness and achievement, making it the perfect scent for life's biggest moments. A spray of Amouage Jubilation XXV Man feels like wearing a crown; it’s confident, luxurious, and unforgettable.

products.title: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum is a fresh and luxurious perfume for men and women. The initial spray is light and energetic, containing grapefruit and bergamot as a sharp citrus touch. Jasmine and magnolia bring soft smoothness to the flower, therefore, it is balanced and clean. Light spice and warmth are introduced as it settles with ginger and herbal notes. The musk, cedar, amber, orris root, and patchouli base provide a creamy woody finish, which lasts many hours. It is very memorable, luxurious and very contemporary and lightweight.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, spicy perfume for both men and women, launched in 2013. It opens warm and sweet with cinnamon, honey and soft fruity osmanthus notes. The middle brings resin, amber and a soft herbal touch that feels deep and cozy. The base is creamy and smooth with vanilla, tonka bean, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and modern unisex perfume from the house of Arabiyat Prestige. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright and playful but also warm at the same time. It begins with rich fruits and citrus flavors, which are vibrant and vivid. As it settles, soft florals and a creamy sweetness start to show, making it smooth and pleasing. The base is warm and woody and a little sweet, making the perfume to be in balance and very comfortable.

products.title: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern fragrance that feels warm, slightly spicy and smooth. The scent opens with a fresh touch of citrus and spices which gives a bright start. After some time aromatic notes begin to appear, adding a soft and elegant feel. As it settles down, woody and amber notes create a warm base that stays on the skin for many hours and gives a classy masculine vibe.

products.title: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and relaxing unisex fragrance inspired by the Italian coast. The fragrance feels very natural, sunny and clean on the skin. The very beginning of the fragrance is dominated by succulent citruses and green herbs, that is, crispness and cheerfulness. The middle notes present a mild floral and spicy aspect, whereas the base remains muted, warm and musky.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and elegant perfume made for women who love floral scents with a creamy touch. It opens fresh and juicy with citrus fruits and gradually turns into a smooth mix of jasmine, fruits and coconut. The base feels warm and comforting with vanilla and amber, making it ideal for daily wear and unique moments too. It smells classy but is still easy to wear, not heavy at all.

products.title: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau de Parfum is a unisex oriental fragrance from Ormonde Jayne, created by Geza Schoen. Launched in 2012, it combines spicy, floral, and woody notes into a smooth, luxurious scent. Orange, bergamot, cardamom, aldehydes and green notes introduce the fragrance with fresh and zesty top notes. The middle notes of the scent are composed of the floral and warm notes of rose, pimento, cinnamon, orchid, magnolia, bay leaf and hedione. Finally, the base notes provide a rich and deep finish of agarwood (oud), ambergris, vetiver, musk and labdanum.

products.title: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a deeper and more intense take on the famous Ani DNA with a fresh fruity opening and creamy sweet woody base. The fragrance opens with bright lemon, bergamot, ginger, melon, cardamom, water notes and pink pepper that feel fresh and lively. The heart brings green apple, black currant, lavender, patchouli, sage and rose, which add a soft, fruity and aromatic touch. The base has smooth vanilla, sandalwood, cashmere wood, cedar, ambergris and white musk that blend and create a warm, sweet trail that stays long and feels elegant.

products.title: Men Office Discovery Set - Montblanc Explorer, Prada L'homme, Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver
products.body_html:
Elevate your professional presence with our Men Office Discovery Set, featuring three premium fragrances:

  • Montblanc Explorer EDP: Embrace adventure with this bold, woody scent that exudes confidence and determination.
  • Prada L'Homme EDT: Experience refined elegance with a sophisticated blend of floral and amber notes, perfect for the modern gentleman.
  • Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver EDP: Discover a fresh, earthy fragrance that combines vetiver with spicy and citrus undertones, ideal for making a lasting impression.

Perfectly curated for the modern professional, these scents embody elegance and confidence, making every day at the office exceptional.

products.title: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and soft perfume that is designed to suit women who place a premium on modern and great style perfumes. The perfume opens with light-hearted and sweet scents of strawberry and raspberry, and cherry berry. The violet and jasmine floral notes come out to produce a feminine touch. Vanilla and musk mixed with the woody in the base notes of the fragrance are warm and smooth on the skin all day long.

products.title: Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum is a sweet, fresh, and playful fragrance that feels like a cosy hug on a winter morning. It blends juicy fruits, soft flowers, and warm, creamy notes to create a scent that is charming yet comforting.

The fragrance opens with a burst of fresh lime, sweet pear, and a hint of almond. Soon, the heart reveals a beautiful mix of candied almond, sugar, and soft peony flowers, making it both sweet and romantic. As it dries down, warm vanilla, tonka bean, amber, and mahogany wood wrap you in a smooth, cosy finish.

Burberry Brit For Her is perfect for women who love a feminine scent that is both casual and classy. It’s the kind of perfume that makes you feel confident and beautiful without being too loud.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Blanche Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: L'Aventure Blanche by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Floral fragrance for women. L'Aventure Blanche was launched in 2017. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Lavender and Rose; middle notes are Black Currant, Jasmine, Orris and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Sandalwood and Amber.

products.title: Roja Parfums Enigma Pour Homme
products.body_html: Roja Parfums Enigma Pour Homme is a rich, warm and classy men’s fragrance created by Roja Dove. Enigma Pour Homme was a perfume that was introduced in the year 2019. It starts with a citrusy and fresh presentation of bergamot, then the scent develops into soft flowers with a hint of spices. The finale is thick, boozy and sweet, comprising cognac, tobacco, vanilla and amber notes.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who love soft sweetness with depth. Launched in 2019, this perfume feels creamy, cozy and classy at the same time. It opens with fresh, spicy notes of juniper berries and nutmeg, which give a clean, airy start. The middle has coriander, adding a soft spicy warmth. The base is where the magic happens, with rich vanilla, soft musk, caramel sweetness and amberwood, creating a long lasting, comforting scent that stays close to the skin.

products.title: Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau De Parfum is a really smooth, warm, and mysterious smell. It feels modern but also comforting, you know? It starts with a soft, fresh burst of orange, that gives Pure Addiction a clean and welcoming start. After a bit, you smell saffron, marigold, and jasmine. This adds a spicy, flowery touch that feels elegant and kind of addictive at the same time. The base smells are white amber, praline, moss, and white cedar. This gives Pure Addiction its rich depth. The creamy sweet of praline mixes perfectly with the wood and musk. 

This makes the scent cozy, sexy, and great for both guys and girls. Pure Addiction has that classy balance of sweet and warm that never smells too strong. Pure Addiction is a smell that slowly gets better on you. It's fresh first, then deep and smooth later. Franck Olivier Pure Addiction is perfect for people who like a sweet perfume but want a bit of edge and warmth too.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Legere Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légère Eau de Parfum is a modern, bold perfume for women. Launched in 2018, it is a lighter and fresher version of the original Good Girl, balancing sweet, floral, and warm notes perfectly. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh top notes of ylang-ylang, mandarin orange, bergamot, and lemon; the heart is full of floral beauty with tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, and Bulgarian rose. The base adds depth with dulche de leche, praline, tonka bean, cinnamon, cashmerwood, sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli, and cedar, leaving a warm, long-lasting trail.

products.title: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy a balanced mix of fresh, floral and deep woody notes. The top notes are sparkling, citrusy scented bergamot and lemon, along with soothing lavender and clary sage. As it settles, scent brings the mixture of sandalwood, rose, jasmine and soft white flowers that are smooth and flowery. The base is very warm and lasts a long time with the presence of oud, amber and musk, which gives it a classy and slightly royal sensation.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum is a deep, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance introduced in 2022. It opens with soft powdery iris mixed with fresh cyclamen and juicy cassis, giving a calm but prosperous start. The heart feels floral and earthy with patchouli, rose and jasmine adding warmth and balance. As it dries down, vanilla, amber and leather come together to create a creamy, slightly sweet and bold base that stays close to skin and feels very luxurious.

products.title: Lalique  White Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Lalique White Eau De Toilette is a fresh Citrus aromatic men's fragrance. It is clean, sharp and classy as soon as it sprays on. The introduction is sunny and lemon leaf and bergamot create a cool and somewhat tangy impression. It is smooth and settles down, unearthing soft spices such as white pepper and cardamom. The cedar and the musk provide a smooth woody foundation in the dry down, which remains on the skin.

products.title: Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is an intense, warm, and truly unforgettable fragrance for men. Inspired by adventure and freedom, this perfume combines the deep warmth of rum with exotic dried fruits, rich spices, and smooth woods. It feels bold yet smooth, giving you a confident vibe that lasts all day.

Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is made for men who like to stand out. A splash of this perfume feels like stepping into a world of luxury, strong, stylish, and full of character. Perfect for evening parties, romantic nights, or when you want to feel your absolute best.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum is a citrus aromatic perfume for both women and men. Moscow Mule was launched in 2017. The nose of Romano Ricci backs this perfume. It starts on new notes of Bergamot, Lime, and Lemon. Ginger, Hedione, and Apple are added to the heart, giving the heart a spicy and slightly fruity touch. It is drying down to White Musk, Woody Notes, Ambrette, and Amberwood and has a clean and smooth finish to it.

products.title: Fragrance World Urban Man Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Urban Man Elixir Eau de Parfum is a modern men's fragrance which is fresh, spicy and woody simultaneously. It begins with a clear combination of bergamot, jasmine and pink pepper, which is light and sleek. Lavender and saffron gradually emerge and introduce a fancy, masculine touch. Amber, patchouli, and cedar are all warm and woody and will be lingering hours upon skin in the dry down. This perfume is assertive, classy, and can be worn both in the daytime and at night.

products.title: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum from Ajmal fragrances is a rich and modern unisex perfume made for people who like deep and bold scents. The top notes are a spicy and flowery blend, which are warm and slightly fresh. After some time, the fragrance becomes woody and smooth with a soft amber touch. The base notes are dark, smoky and musky, resembling an intense Middle Eastern essence that is very close to skin and very elegant.

products.title: Rabanne After Club Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne After Club Eau de Parfum is a new unisex scent from Rabanne Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a smooth woody, aromatic fragrance that feels clean, warm and slightly sweet. The scent opens with fresh lavender, then moves into a soft heart of vanilla and labdanum and settles into a warm amber base.

products.title: French Avenue Sultan the Founder Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Sultan The Founder Eau de Parfum is a creamy oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It opens strong and deep with classic Middle Eastern vibes and slowly turns warm and smooth on skin. The blend feels bold, royal and confident, made for people who like strong perfumes with character. It has a dark woody feel with animalic warmth in the base that stays for long hours.

products.title: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum for Men & Women is a strong perfume. It is an incredible blend of warm spice and smooth wood notes. The scent kicks off with a fresh burst of rosemary, lemon, bergamot, and basil. This gives it a clean, slightly spicy opening. The middle layer has a lot going on: benzoin, heliotrope, cardamom, patchouli, tuberose, lavender, and oakmoss. This adds a lot of depth, plus creamy sweetness and rich herbs. The bottom notes are heavy. You get vanilla, amber, incense, sandalwood, and leather. Musk and cedar soften the whole thing up. This makes the entire scent finish deep and totally luxurious.

products.title: Clive Christian X Masculine Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Clive Christian X Masculine Eau de Parfum provides a masculine scent that is very luxurious and elegant, with a warm and opulent smell. The perfume starts off with a fresh and sweet aroma of pineapple and bergamot mixed with rhubarb. The perfume moves on to a blend of tender iris and jasmine, with a touch of spicy paprika to make it a luxurious and sophisticated feel. The fragrance base is made of a strong woody aroma of cedar and amber, combined with vanilla and cinnamon to produce a strong masculine smell that will last the day.

products.title: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum is a clean and fresh unisex fragrance that is bright immediately after spraying. It begins with crisp citron, which smells natural, juicy, and bitter to some extent. Warm ginger is then added, providing a mild spicy feel. Musk, woody and ambergris at the bottom form a long-lasting and smooth finish. It is easy and elegant, contemporary and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum is a modern and lavish unisex fragrance that characterizes the house of Rasasi. It has clean and bright citrusy and fruity notes that come through fresh and a bit green. The scent, as it matures, gives off warmth, softness, spices, sweetness and a little floral fragrance. The base is strong and gentle with some leather, musk, woods and earth notes that last on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum is a bold, dark and deep unisex perfume from the house of Nasomatto. This fragrance is known for its intense woody and smoky feel with a rich and mysterious character. It opens with strong green and herbal notes mixed with a dark earthy touch, slowly moving into warm resins, coffee and tobacco. The base is heavy, long lasting and very strong with a powerful mix of oud, incense, amber and musky notes that stay on the skin for hours.

products.title: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and modern women’s perfume for those who love sweet but balanced scents. It opens fresh and juicy with pineapple, mandarin and bergamot that feel bright and happy. Slowly, it turns smooth and cozy with suede and sandalwood at its middle notes. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, white musk, birch and ambergris, giving it a clean yet slightly woody finish.

products.title: Armani Prive Oud Royal Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Oud Royal Intense Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from the house of Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a deep and fragrance built around classic oriental woody accords. The perfume opens with saffron and rose giving a warm, spicy start; the heart is a smoky mix of agarwood (oud) and incense; the base settles into creamy sandalwood and amber for a long-lasting, elegant finish. It is perfect for anyone who loves a bold, sophisticated, and timeless scent.

products.title: Al Haramain White Oudh Attar Roll On
products.body_html: White Oudh by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Artemisia, Lemon, Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Freesia, Patchouli and Black Currant; base notes are Tobacco, Amber and Musk.

products.title: Al Haramain Makkah Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Makkah by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Citruses and Green Notes; middle notes are Big Strawberry, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Resins, Amber, Powdery Notes, Vanilla and Musk.

products.title: Al Haramain Black Oud Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Black Oudh by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Top note is Musk; middle notes are Cedar and Herbal Notes; base notes are Amber, Patchouli and Vanilla.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Amber by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Spicy Notes, Saffron, Geranium, Cloves, Lemon and Lavender; middle notes are Sandalwood, Rose, Cedar, Orris and Artemisia; base notes are Amber, Patchouli, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Musk and Amyris.

products.title: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich perfume for men who like strong, classy scents. It has a warm, amber and leather feel and a sweet and spicy touch. This men’s perfume is inspired by 1 Million Parfum by Paco Rabanne, but it still has its own strong character. It is fresh and juicy on the opening, spicy and floral in the middle and deep, warm and slightly smoky on the base.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Hair Mist
products.body_html: Club de Nuit Intense Man by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Club de Nuit Intense Man was launched in 2015. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Bergamot, Black Currant and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.

products.title: Rue Broca L'Alliance Stellar Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca L'Alliance Stellar Eau de Parfum is a deep and warm unisex fragrance that feels rich and woody from the first spray. The opening comes with smoky incense mixed with sharp rhubarb and earthy vetiver, giving it a bold start. Slowly, rose and sweet tonka blend with amber in the heart, adding warmth and smoothness. The base of oud, sandalwood, cedar, and amber gives a strong woody finish that stays for long hours on skin.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent offers a creamy, floral and warm spicy style that feels classy yet bold. It opens with a lively mix of black pepper and juicy lychee, offering a fresh, spicy sweet start. The heart blooms with soft damask rose and warm amber, giving a smooth floral warmth. The base note of patchouli adds depth and a slightly earthy touch that blends nicely and stays long on skin.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum is an exquisite combination of sweetness, class, and confidence, which is the perfect fit for women who desire to be in the limelight. The fragrance starts with a mixture of delicious raspberry and sparkling lemon that is so fresh and cheerful. Then the gentle white flowers such as jasmine and orange blossom appear and add a rich, feminine note. The honey and patchouli support the fragrance as warm, soft, and very enduring on the skin. The scent is sophisticated, daring, and very attractive.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Shower Gel
products.body_html: Sailing Day by Maison Martin Margiela is a fragrance for women and men. Sailing Day was launched in 2017. Top notes are Sea Notes, Aldehydes, Coriander and Red Pepper; middle notes are Juniper, Iris, Amyl Salicylate and Rose; base notes are Seaweed, Ambergris, Cedar and Amberwood.

products.body_html: Sailing Day by Maison Martin Margiela is a fragrance for women and men. Sailing Day was launched in 2017. Top notes are Sea Notes, Aldehydes, Coriander and Red Pepper; middle notes are Juniper, Iris, Amyl Salicylate and Rose; base notes are Seaweed, Ambergris, Cedar and Amberwood.

products.title: Diptyque  Solution Hand Wash
products.body_html:
Hailed since antiquity, fine lavender from Provence lends its regenerative qualities to this soothing hand wash.
Restoring the gentle feel of the skin, it also delivers lavender and rosemary notes softened by subtle accents of ylang-ylang and amber.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and warm perfume that is designed to be used by men and women alike. It begins with gentle vanilla orchid and ylang ylang that is blended in with the touch of whipped cream that is rich and comforting. The heart is serving rose and peony with a small twist of fruity blackcurrant. Caramel, woods and incense render it deep in the dry down, sweet and to a certain extent smoky. It is classy, welcoming and highly enjoyable.

products.title: Men Luxe Discovery Set - Amouage Interlude, Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim, Acqua Di Parma Leather
products.body_html:
Indulge in luxury with our Men Luxe Discovery Set, featuring three exceptional fragrances:

  • Amouage Interlude EDP: Immerse yourself in a complex blend of spices, amber, and smoky accords, delivering a rich and captivating scent.
  • Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim EDP: Immerse yourself in a refreshing blend of citrus notes, delivering a vibrant and invigorating scent perfect for a sunlit adventure.
  • Acqua di Parma Leather EDP: Experience the refined leather accord, complemented by woody and citrus notes, embodying timeless luxury and sophistication.

Perfectly curated for the discerning gentleman, these scents exude opulence and class.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau De Parfum is a rich and smooth unisex fragrance built around soft roses, warm oud and a sweet, creamy base. The scent opens with gentle Bulgarian rose, violet and a small sweet touch of strawberry. Then, the Turkish rose is delivered in the middle. Finally comes the burnished creamy mixture of oud, vanilla, amber, benzoin, caramel and cedar, which merges into a warm, silky, long-lasting scent that is somewhat sweet and very elegant.
